steps.caption: Tap New game: two tiles to start
steps.shows: Empty board with two 2 tiles, score 0

steps.caption: Swipe on the board: every tile slides that way
steps.shows: Swiped down: the two 2s at the bottom, a new 4 appeared; score 0

steps.caption: Two the same meet and merge, and the score goes up
steps.shows: Swiped left: the two 2s merged into a 4; score 4, best 4

steps.caption: Tiles get bolder as they grow; from 128 they're white on black
steps.shows: After more swipes: a 128 tile (white on black) in the corner, score 1000

steps.caption: Keep your biggest tile in a corner and build towards it
steps.shows: A 256 tile in the corner, score 1820

steps.caption: When nothing can slide, the game's over; your best score is kept
steps.shows: 'No moves left. A new best: 2948. Press OK for a new game' over a full board; New game filled
